title: Optional and many arguments
description:
Write four functions:

```lua-norun
greet(name, greeting)   -- "Hello, Ada!"; greeting defaults to "Hello", name to "there"
join(sep, ...)          -- every argument after sep, turned into text with tostring and joined with sep;
                        -- nil arguments count too: join("-", 1, nil, 3) is "1-nil-3"
count_args(...)         -- how many arguments were passed, nils included
pad(options)            -- options.text padded with spaces to options.width (default 10);
                        -- options.align is "left" (default) or "right"; text longer than width is unchanged
```

```lua-norun
pad{ text = "hi", width = 5 }                    --> "hi   "
pad{ text = "hi", width = 5, align = "right" }   --> "   hi"
```

solution.solution.lua:
function greet(name, greeting)
    name = name or "there"
    greeting = greeting or "Hello"
    return greeting .. ", " .. name .. "!"
end

function join(sep, ...)
    local n = select("#", ...)
    local args = table.pack(...)
    local parts = {}
    for i = 1, n do parts[i] = tostring(args[i]) end
    return table.concat(parts, sep)
end

function count_args(...)
    return select("#", ...)
end

function pad(options)
    local text = options.text
    local width = options.width or 10
    local spaces = string.rep(" ", math.max(0, width - #text))
    if options.align == "right" then
        return spaces .. text
    end
    return text .. spaces
end

hints: `select("#", ...)` counts every argument, nils included; `{ ... }` and `#` do not.
`string.rep(" ", n)` makes n spaces; with `n` of 0 or less it gives `""`.
unitTests:
test("greet with defaults", function()
    check_eq(greet("Ada"), "Hello, Ada!")
    check_eq(greet("Ada", "Hi"), "Hi, Ada!")
    check_eq(greet(), "Hello, there!")
    check_eq(greet(nil, "Welcome"), "Welcome, there!")
end)

test("join turns everything into text", function()
    check_eq(join(", ", "a", "b", "c"), "a, b, c")
    check_eq(join("-", 1, true, 2.5), "1-true-2.5")
    check_eq(join("-"), "")
end)

test("join keeps nil arguments", function()
    check_eq(join("-", 1, nil, 3), "1-nil-3")
    check_eq(join("+", nil), "nil")
    check_eq(join(" ", "x", nil), "x nil")
end)

test("count_args counts nils", function()
    check_eq(count_args(), 0)
    check_eq(count_args(1, 2, 3), 3)
    check_eq(count_args(nil, nil), 2)
    check_eq(count_args(1, nil), 2)
end)

test("pad", function()
    check_eq(pad{ text = "hi", width = 5 }, "hi   ")
    check_eq(pad{ text = "hi", width = 5, align = "right" }, "   hi")
    check_eq(pad{ text = "lua" }, "lua       ")
    check_eq(pad{ text = "too long", width = 3 }, "too long")
    check_eq(pad{ text = "", width = 2, align = "left" }, "  ")
end)
